scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run prod --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:use-test-db: concurrently "npm run dev:test --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
